description: Siemens (Pakistan) Engineering Company Limited was incorporated in Pakistan in 1953, though Siemens opened its first office in what is now Pakistan in Lahore in 1922. It is a public limited company quoted on the Pakistan Stock Exchange, principally engaged in executing projects under contracts and in the manufacturing, sale and installation of electronic and electrical capital goods.
